mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and 74 degrees at the Verona Area High School. We are currently under a Waxing Gibbous moon, and keep an eye on the sky early tomorrow morning at 3:25 AM, when the International Space Station will be visible rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward Madison near Home Depot.
City Hall reports that there are no new important emails in the system today, so we are clear on that front.

You have plenty to look forward to, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, and check out the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday.
Looking at the weekly police report, on August 19, officers responded to North Main Street at Bering Drive for a motor vehicle accident where injuries were thankfully minor.
Stop by for the Dark Chocolate PB Crunch flavor of the day. The store is open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to grab a scoop.
